original: 大哉乾元，**万物资始**，乃统天。
vernacular_zh: 伟大啊，乾的创始之力！万物都靠它开始，它统领着整个天道。
translation_en: Vast is the 'great and originating (power)' indicated by Qian! All things owe to it their beginning: it contains all the meaning belonging to (the name) heaven.

scripture.text_zh: 万物是藉着他造的；凡被造的，没有一样不是藉着他造的。
scripture.text_en: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

insight_zh: 易经：乾元是**天道之力**；约翰：太初的道**是位格的神**。
insight_en: I Ching: Qian is **the power of heaven**. John: the Word **is a personal God**.
